name: FENG LIU
abstract_title: Cosmic Holographic Axiom System: A Unified Framework for Describing Reality
abstract: This paper aims to propose and elaborate a cosmic descriptive system based on the holographic principle—the “Cosmic Holographic Axiom”. Composed of seven core axioms, the system starts from the essence of space, progresses through the basic forms and complex compositions of existence, and ultimately converges to the core concept of “holography”. The axiom system reveals the spatial structure from zero dimension to N dimension (N→∞), demonstrates that all existence can be simplified to sine waves
affiliation: American Institute of Holographic Life Sciences
notable: Former Silicon Valley executive; degree in engineering optics
